name: Workspace
menuDescription: Keep every source beside the conversation
title: Everything you need, beside the conversation.
description: Keep webpages, files, messages, tasks, and other useful material beside your Polymux conversation.
intro: Polymux gives your assistant a real place to work. Instead of hiding every step in a stream of messages, it opens the useful material beside your conversation so you can follow along and stay in control.
imageAlt: A Polymux conversation with a workspace view open beside it

benefits.title: Stay oriented
benefits.description: See the page, file, message, or task behind an answer without leaving the conversation.

benefits.title: Move naturally
benefits.description: Keep several views open as tabs, switch between them, and resize the workspace around what you are doing.

benefits.title: Keep work together
benefits.description: The conversation and its supporting material remain part of the same task instead of being scattered across apps.

steps: Ask Polymux for help as you normally would.
A useful file, page, conversation, or task opens beside the chat.
Review it, keep it open, or switch to another view while the conversation continues.

example.title: Plan a trip without tab chaos
example.description: Keep a booking page, a saved itinerary, and a conversation with your travel companion open together while Polymux helps you compare the options.

name: Hub
menuDescription: Bring messages and email into one inbox
title: Messages and email, in one calm place.
description: Read, reply to, and work with supported messages and email from one Polymux inbox.
intro: Hub brings the conversations that matter into one workspace. You can catch up, reply, and ask Polymux to help with the selected thread without constantly jumping between services.
imageAlt: The Polymux Hub showing connected conversations and a selected thread

benefits.title: One place to catch up
benefits.description: See supported messaging services and email accounts in a single, familiar view.

benefits.title: Help with the right context
benefits.description: Ask for a summary, a draft, or an action while the relevant conversation is already selected.

benefits.title: You choose when to be seen
benefits.description: Use Incognito Mode with supported connections when you want to read without marking a message as seen.

steps: Connect the messaging and email accounts you want to use.
Choose a conversation from the Hub rail.
Reply yourself or ask Polymux to summarise, draft, find, or act on what is there.

example.title: Turn an email into finished work
example.description: Open a request from a colleague, ask Polymux to find the related file, prepare a reply, and keep both visible until you are ready to send.

name: Drive
menuDescription: Work across local and cloud files
title: Your files, wherever they already live.
description: Browse and work with local folders, cloud drives, network storage, and supported object storage in Polymux.
intro: Drive gives you and your assistant one consistent way to work with files. Keep local folders and connected storage available without turning every task into a hunt through separate windows.
imageAlt: The Polymux Drive showing folders and files in the workspace

benefits.title: Bring storage together
benefits.description: Browse local folders, supported cloud drives, network folders, and S3-compatible storage from one view.

benefits.title: Know where outputs belong
benefits.description: Files created during a conversation stay connected to the work that produced them.

benefits.title: Choose your preferred home
benefits.description: Arrange storage destinations so new files go to the place that makes sense for you.

steps: Connect the folders and storage services you want Polymux to use.
Browse or search from Drive, or simply describe the file you need.
Open, organise, or create files while keeping the task visible beside them.

example.title: Build a report from scattered files
example.description: Ask Polymux to find notes in a local folder, images in cloud storage, and the latest draft, then keep the selected material together while the report takes shape.

name: Browser
title: Research without losing the conversation.
description: Browse, research, and keep useful webpages beside your Polymux conversation.
intro: Browser keeps web research close to the question that started it. Polymux can open pages in its built-in browser, keep the useful ones as tabs, and pause when a website needs your attention.
imageAlt: The Polymux Browser open beside a conversation

benefits.title: Research in context
benefits.description: Keep sources beside the conversation instead of losing the trail across a separate browser window.

benefits.title: Use the right tab
benefits.description: Polymux works with the built-in browser or an external tab you explicitly assign when that is what the task needs.

benefits.title: Sensitive moments stay yours
benefits.description: Sign-ins, CAPTCHAs, payments, and other personal checkpoints can be handed back to you.

steps: Ask a question that needs current information or open Browser yourself.
Polymux visits relevant pages and keeps useful sources available as tabs.
Review the source beside the answer and take over whenever a personal decision is required.

example.title: Compare before you buy
example.description: Keep the official product page, an independent review, and your shortlist visible together while Polymux helps you compare the details that matter to you.

name: Memory
title: An assistant that remembers what matters.
description: Let Polymux retain useful preferences, project context, and boundaries between conversations.
intro: Memory helps Polymux pick up where you left off. It is designed for useful, durable context—such as how you like to work or what a project is about—without treating every old conversation as equally important.

demoItems.label: Preference
demoItems.title: Keep answers concise
demoItems.description: A stable way you like Polymux to communicate.

demoItems.label: Project
demoItems.title: Polymux website
demoItems.description: The product and workspace you are actively building.

demoItems.label: Boundary
demoItems.title: Ask before publishing
demoItems.description: An important rule that should carry into later work.

benefits.title: Start with less repetition
benefits.description: Useful preferences and project context can carry into a new conversation.

benefits.title: Keep additions reviewable
benefits.description: Explicit memories are recorded visibly instead of silently rewriting everything in the background.

benefits.title: Stay in control
benefits.description: Memory is local, separate from recent-screen history, and can be inspected or turned off.

steps: Polymux notices when earlier context may help with a new request.
It retrieves only the relevant parts instead of loading every previous conversation.
You can explicitly ask it to remember something important or review the memory settings.

example.title: Continue a project next week
example.description: Return to a project in a fresh conversation and let Polymux recover the important decisions, your preferred style, and the remaining boundaries without a long recap.

name: Tasks & schedules
menuDescription: Plan, delegate, and run work later
title: Work that keeps moving when you step away.
description: Track work, delegate focused pieces, and schedule recurring requests with Polymux.
intro: Not every request should stay trapped in one long conversation. Polymux can keep work visible as tasks, hand focused pieces to subagents, and run repeatable requests on a schedule.
imageAlt: The Polymux Tasks view showing work and its progress

benefits.title: See what is happening
benefits.description: Follow work that is active, completed, or waiting for attention from the Tasks view.

benefits.title: Work in parallel
benefits.description: Polymux Agent can delegate bounded pieces of a larger request while remaining responsible for the final result.

benefits.title: Make routines automatic
benefits.description: Schedule repeatable checks, summaries, and monitoring jobs for later.

steps: Describe the outcome, including whether it should happen now or repeat later.
Polymux tracks the work and may delegate clearly separated pieces when useful.
Review progress and results from the workspace, with notifications when configured.

example.title: Make a weekly review effortless
example.description: Schedule a Friday summary, let Polymux gather the relevant updates, and open the finished result when it is ready instead of rebuilding the routine each week.

name: Models & agents
menuDescription: Choose the intelligence behind your workspace
title: Your choice of intelligence, one familiar workspace.
description: Use hosted models, local models, Polymux Agent, or a compatible external agent without replacing your workspace.
intro: Polymux separates the assistant experience from the AI running behind it. Choose a hosted service, use a model on your own computer, or connect a compatible agent while keeping the same conversations, files, and controls.

demoItems.label: Hosted
demoItems.title: Leading AI providers
demoItems.description: Use a convenient online model for everyday work.

demoItems.label: Local
demoItems.title: Models on your computer
demoItems.description: Keep suitable work on hardware you control.

demoItems.label: Compatible agents
demoItems.title: Bring another runtime
demoItems.description: Connect supported agents without giving up the Polymux workspace.

benefits.title: Choose for each kind of work
benefits.description: Different profiles can use different models, providers, tools, and agent runtimes.

benefits.title: Switch without starting over
benefits.description: Changing the intelligence behind Polymux does not remove your existing chats or workspace content.

benefits.title: Keep one familiar experience
benefits.description: Polymux continues to provide the conversation, workspace, history, and permission controls around the selected agent.

steps: Connect the hosted or local providers you want available.
Choose a model or compatible agent for the current profile.
Use the same Polymux workspace while the selected intelligence handles future work.

example.title: Match the model to the moment
example.description: Use a fast hosted model for everyday questions, a local model for suitable private work, and a specialised compatible agent for a focused workflow—all without changing apps.

name: Skills & tools
title: Make Polymux useful for the way you work.
description: Give Polymux trusted skills and connected tools for the workflows, services, and routines you use.
intro: Skills give Polymux a reliable way to approach recurring work. Connected tools let it reach the services needed for a task. Together, they turn a general assistant into one that understands your preferred workflow.
demoTitle: A workflow, not just a prompt

demoItems.label: Skill
demoItems.title: Your preferred process
demoItems.description: A repeatable way to prepare, check, and finish a kind of task.

demoItems.label: Tool
demoItems.title: The service it needs
demoItems.description: A connected app or source that supplies the real information.

demoItems.label: Permission
demoItems.title: Your decision boundary
demoItems.description: A clear point where Polymux asks before anything sensitive happens.

benefits.title: Be consistent
benefits.description: A trusted skill helps Polymux follow the same useful process each time.

benefits.title: Connect the right services
benefits.description: Tools and MCP servers can make information and actions available to the current profile.

benefits.title: Keep boundaries clear
benefits.description: Connecting a tool does not mean every sensitive action should happen without your approval.

steps: Add trusted skills and connections for the work you want Polymux to handle.
Polymux selects the relevant guidance and tools when a request matches.
You stay involved at permission, account, payment, publishing, and other important checkpoints.

example.title: Turn your routine into a reliable workflow
example.description: Give Polymux your preferred job-search process, connect the sources it needs, and keep application submission as a clear approval step that remains yours.
